# Developer resources for nhanaz.io.vn

This scoped file is for agents and small tools that need the machine-readable entry points for this static personal archive.

- [Developer resource page](https://nhanaz.io.vn/en/developers/)
- [Full machine-readable context](https://nhanaz.io.vn/llms-full.txt)
- [Site identity graph](https://nhanaz.io.vn/entity.json)
- [Canonical URL list](https://nhanaz.io.vn/sitemap.xml)
- [Agent guidance](https://nhanaz.io.vn/agent.md)
- [ARD catalog](https://nhanaz.io.vn/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
- [Agent Skills index](https://nhanaz.io.vn/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
- [Authentication note](https://nhanaz.io.vn/auth.md)
- [Pricing note](https://nhanaz.io.vn/pricing.md)
- [RFC 9727 API catalog](https://nhanaz.io.vn/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [Schema map](https://nhanaz.io.vn/schema-map.xml)

The archive content is read-only. It has no user account, authentication flow, webhook, or endpoint for changing data. A small public `GET /api/views?path=/...` counter increments view totals without accepting credentials. Read the canonical page before quoting a claim, and use the GitHub repository for source history and repository rules.
